ana: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — sketching a small set of rollout/canary improvements we should own and ship. Short list: auto-decay for long-lived flags, sampling schedules with enforced minimum observation windows, and a telemetry gate that blocks ramp beyond canary on signal. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-15-rollout-regression

mo: Love this. Can we make it actionable here — owner + clear deadline for each item?

ana: Typo — it's ana :) I'll start. Proposed owners + deadlines:
- Auto-decay for flags -> samir -> EOW (Mar 27)
- Sampling schedule + enforced observation windows -> mo -> Apr 3
- Telemetry gate (pre-ramp) -> tj -> Mar 30
- Staging simulation + runbook snippet -> lisa-sre -> Apr 1
I'll create OPS-4721 and link PRs there.

samir: I can take auto-decay. Plan: add decay metadata to feature-flag service and a periodic reconciler that unflags after TTL unless renewed. Will add an override for emergency persists. ETA EOW.

mo: For sampling schedules I'll implement a schema so flags declare schedule rather than one-off percent bumps. Example config I have in mind:
```
flag: new-ranking
sampling_schedule:
  t0: 1%
  t1: 5%
  t2: 25%
  t3: 100%
observation_windows:
  - window: 5m
    min_requests: 1000
  - window: 15m
    min_requests: 5000
```
This enforces we don't ramp until we have enough observations. Will PR by next week.

tj: I'll own telemetry gate. Suggest we gate on three signals: error_rate delta, p95 latency delta, and a business-key metric (e.g., search success). Proposal: block ramp if any signal exceeds threshold for 2 consecutive observation windows. Example rule: error_rate +5% sustained for 2x5m windows -> pause and auto-rollback. I'll add a simulator that replays canary traffic to validate thresholds. Opening RFC today.

lisa-sre: Add one more safety: per-flag blast-radius caps (max concurrent users in canary) so a bad canary can't touch too many upstream services. Also need runbook steps for triage and emergency rollback commands in the console. I'll draft runbook and test in staging.

deploy-bot: deploy: Canary rollout for feature/new-ranking started on staging by @mo — build 2026.3.45

mo: small note: sampling_schedule should include a hard quota to avoid runaway when metrics are noisy. I'll add a 'quota_limit' param.

ana: Quick checklist I'm adding to OPS-4721 (I'll post link once created):
- [ ] Samir: implement auto-decay + emergency persist (EOW)
- [ ] Mo: sampling schedule schema + quota_limit (Apr 3)
- [ ] TJ: telemetry gate RFC + simulator (Mar 30)
- [ ] Lisa-sre: runbook + staging tests (Apr 1)
- [ ] Platform: add alert rule for rollout gating failures (owner TBC)

samir: I'll also include a safety flag to disable auto-decay globally for any critical path flags — ops-only.

tj: One more ask: add a short integration test in our canary harness that intentionally spikes an error signal to verify the gate triggers auto-rollback. I'll pair with mo on this.

ana: Perfect — let's sync on a 15-min slot tomorrow to confirm owners and close OPS-4721. Thanks all :thumbsup:
